description:
FILED s527d (2026-10-31), found probing §9.  `"ab" =~ /(a)/; print "$#{+}\n";` -- perl 5.40.3 prints 1; PCL (main df8e1ec9 and the s527d tree alike) drops the print statement loudly ('Handle single node of unknown type').  The CODE spelling `$#{+}` and `$#+` work; only the interpolated braced form fails -- Pl::InterpScan / StringInterpolation's `$#{...}` arm does not ask Pl::PExpr::braced_punct_magic_name.  Pre-existing; the PPI side (§9) is not involved (strings are PCL's own scan).

=== DONE (s532a) ===
FIXED (63c1188a): Pl::InterpScan::_scan_array_index's `$#{...}` arm takes a braced PUNCTUATION name as the `${...}` / `@{...}` arms do (_braced_magic_name); a caret name keeps the expression path (it reads it right; routing it as magic broke `$#{^CAPTURE}`).  Guard Pl/t/punct-array-glob-01.t row 47 (perl oracle; inverse-verified).
subject: PCL: \"$#{+}\" / \"$#{-}\" inside a double-quoted string DROPS the statement (Handle single node of unknown type)
